action.description: What to do: list_apps, get_app_state to read an app's window, or click, type_text, press_key, scroll, drag, set_value, or perform_secondary_action on it; record its window as a video, and stop_recording to stop and keep it.

app.description: The app, by its name or bundle id, such as "Simulator" or "com.apple.iphonesimulator". Every action but list_apps and stop_recording names one.

element_index.description: An element's number, as the app's last get_app_state numbered it.

x.description: A point's x in the pixels of the app's last screenshot, for click.

y.description: A point's y in the pixels of the app's last screenshot, for click.

click_count.description: How many times click presses, 2 for a double-click; 1 when left out.

mouse_button.description: Which button click presses; left when left out.

text.description: What type_text types into the app's focused element.

key.description: What press_key presses, xdotool-style, such as "Return", "Tab", or "super+c".

direction.description: Which way scroll moves; down when left out.

pages.description: How far scroll moves, in pages; 1 when left out.

from_x.description: Where drag starts, in the pixels of the app's last screenshot.

from_y.description: Where drag starts, in the pixels of the app's last screenshot.

to_x.description: Where drag ends, in the pixels of the app's last screenshot.

to_y.description: Where drag ends, in the pixels of the app's last screenshot.

value.description: What set_value sets a settable element to.

secondary_action.description: Which of the element's secondary actions perform_secondary_action performs, as its state names them, such as "AXShowMenu".

caption.description: What the recording shows, in one line, which the transcript shows under it.

description.description: What the command is for, in plain English for the developer reading along: 3 to 8 words, sentence case, no trailing period, such as "Run the unit tests" or "Find where invites are sent".

machine.description: The machine to run on, by its name, where the conversation asks for one other than your default machine; a call refused for its machine names the ones that can take it. Leave it out for your default machine.
